n = int(input())
b = int(input())
array = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]

resultCount = 0
totalSum = 0
oddCounter = 0
evenCounter = 0
diffValues = []

for i in range(n):
    if array[i] % 2 != 0:
        oddCounter += 1
    else:
        evenCounter += 1
    if i != n - 1 and oddCounter == evenCounter:
        diffValues.append(abs(array[i + 1] - array[i]))

diffValues.sort()

for val in diffValues:
    totalSum += val
    if totalSum <= b:
        resultCount += 1
    else:
        break

print(resultCount)
